Three printed trade cards advertise a Chimayo handwoven wool blanket, Donaciano Vigil and Company, and Lorenzo Hubbell Jr. A small drawing shows a weaver at a loom.

Written text (transcribed as written):
Upper blanket label: “A CHIMAYO WEAVER AT HIS LOOM © CHIMAYO BLANKET GUARANTEED ALL WOOL HAND WOVEN NATIVE WEAVING OF THE SOUTHWEST COST [blank] PRICE [illegible handwritten code] NO. [blank] SIZE 54 x 84 ADRT 32.50”
Lower left card: “TOURIST HOME, SPRING WATER, WOOD AND CAMP SUPPLIES, GOOD FISHING DONACIANO VIGIL & CO. GENERAL MERCHANDISE PLENTY OF SHADE, GENUINE SPANISH MEALS IF DESIRED GAS AND OIL, ON SANTA FE AND TAOS TRAIL 18 MILES FROM TAOS, 66 FROM SANTA FE LOOK FOR BRIDGE CROSSING RIO GRANDE PILAR N. MEX.”
Lower right card: “EVERYTHING FOR THE INDIAN AND BY THE INDIAN WHOLESALE TO INDIAN TRADE LORENZO HUBBELL, JR. WINSLOW, ARIZONA RETAIL AND WHOLESALE GENUINE NAVAJO INDIAN RUGS---NAVAJO INDIAN SILVERWARE HOPI RUGS, POTTERY AND BASKETS ALL GOODS SHIPPED ON APPROVAL---SATISFACTION GUARANTEED”
